facts.text: Six Senses Fiji is on Malolo Island.
facts.excerpt: Sublime Malolo Island is the tropical setting for Six Senses Fiji resort

facts.text: The resort is 16 miles (25 kilometers) from Nadi International Airport.
facts.excerpt: only 16 miles (25 kilometers) from Nadi International Airport (NAN)

facts.text: Malolo Island is the largest of the Mamanuca Islands.
facts.excerpt: Six Senses Fiji enjoys a prime position on Malolo Island, the largest of the Mamanuca Islands

facts.text: The resort is surrounded by crystal clear waters and white sand beaches.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by crystal clear waters and white sand beaches

facts.text: Accommodation is pool villas plus residences with three to six bedrooms.
facts.excerpt: features just 24 spacious pool villas plus an inventory of residences with three to six bedrooms

facts.text: Villas and residences have private pools and westerly outlooks over the bay.
facts.excerpt: plus multi-bedroom luxury residences and retreats, with private pools, and westerly outlooks over the bay

facts.text: Accommodation combines traditional style with advanced technologies, private pools and ocean access.
facts.excerpt: Traditional style with advanced technologies, private pools and ocean access

facts.text: Residences include a huge pool and deck, a fully equipped kitchen and spacious living spaces.
facts.excerpt: Opt for a multiple-room residence that includes a huge pool and deck, fully equipped kitchen, and spacious living spaces.

facts.text: Residences are set in lush vegetation, with beachfront, ocean or marina views.
facts.excerpt: Set in lush vegetation, choose panoramic beachfront, ocean or marina views.

facts.text: The resort is home to Fijian crested iguanas, a critically endangered species, in a protected habitat within the resort.
facts.excerpt: Six Senses Fiji is home to 43 Fijian crested iguanas, a critically endangered species.

facts.text: Guests can join an Iguana Spotting experience.
facts.excerpt: Join our Iguana Spotting experience to see these elusive creatures in the wild.

facts.text: Surfing, family time and wellness at the resort take their cue from the water.
facts.excerpt: Surfing, family time, and wellness all take their cue from the water

facts.text: The spa offers Six Senses holistic treatments.
facts.excerpt: Six Senses holistic treatments create a layered approach to wellness

facts.text: RaRa serves dinner with different themed menus each evening.
facts.excerpt: Dinner at RaRa offers an array of tastes, offering different themed menus each evening.

facts.text: Tovolea serves international fare with a Pacific flair.
facts.excerpt: Tovolea dining features international fare with a Pacific flair.
